column1: # Bengali adjudicated GOLD — hand-verified standard (Kolkata/standard-colloquial) pronunciations of common
# words, in OUR canonical convention (tap ɾ, dental t̪/d̪, retroflex ʈ/ɖ, affricate ties, inherent /ɔ/,
# harmony ɔ→o / e→æ, inherent-vowel deletion). A CLEAN, consistent quality signal — decoupled from the noisy
# wikipron ben referee (which is inconsistent on retroflex-vs-dental and literary final-[o] retention).
# --- 2026-07-16 expansion (50→147): common vocabulary, each cross-checked against the independent wikipron
# (68 corroborated) or adjudicated where wikipron is absent/notation-only. The final block is words the RULE
# engine currently MISSES (lexical closed-syllable ɔ→o মন/কলম/গরম; medial-ɔ retention পুরনো; bô-phola লম্বা) —
# kept at their true Kolkata form so the gold reflects the real error rate; these are the curated-lexicon targets.
